english: Akihabara! Dejiko's back, nyo-!
Whoa… what an amazing city.\nSo many people…
Like people are trash, nyo?
I feel like I'd get lost here.
Worse than lost- if you let your guard down,\nsome shady creep will take you home, nyo.
Is she talking about me? Me?
Everyone stay close☆\nIf you get separated, scream for help, okay?
Understood, I am.
Group activities just aren't my thing.
Can't exactly use IS casually around here.\nThere are so many shops I wanna check out,\nbut I'll hold back for now.
To Gamers, nyo!
So that's the shop Dejiko-chan works at.\nI wonder what it's like? Like?
Isn't it this one?\nThe flyer they were handing out on the street\nsays Gamers on it.
It's a game shop.\n…What's this? A new-manager\ncelebration campaign?
Nyo? What do you mean, new manager, nyo!?\nDid the manager get fired, nyo!?
Dejiko, calm down, you must.
How can I stay calm, nyo!\nThe manager is Dejiko's benefactor, nyo!\nA new manager is no joke, nyo-!!
//Dejiko runs off.
Wait! If Dejiko-san, who knows the area,\ngets separated,\nwhat then!?
We have no choice but to chase her.\nEveryone, run!
//Scene change\n//Background: in front of Gamers\n//Usada appears
Welcome to Gamers!\nWe're running our new-manager celebration\ncampaign! Thanks for shopping with us!
//Dejiko comes running.
You there, part-timer! Bring out this so-called new manager of Gamers, nyo!\nHurry up, nyo!!
Oh my, who do we have here but\nDejiko the panty-flasher.
Usada!? What are you doing, nyo!?
Don't call me Usada!\nCall me RabiiennRose!
I wouldn't say it even if I died a hundred million and two thousand\ntimes, nyoo.
You only get to die once!\nIt's not like you're that old dude who\nstomps turtles to multiply forever!
Never mind that- bring out the new manager, nyo!\nDejiko won't allow a takeover, nyo!
Oh my, Dejiko, have you ruined your eyes\nplaying too many games?\nYou can't even see the new manager?
My eyes are so healthy they shoot beams, nyo!
Then say the name of what you're glaring at\nright now.\nThat's your answer.
So that means…
You're the new manager…?
Ding ding, correctt!!
Nyo!?
I'm RabiiennRose, Gamers' new manager.\nPleased to meetcha!
That's… impossible, nyo…!
If dumb Usada becomes manager, bankruptcy in three months\nis guaranteed, nyo!!
Don't throw out such oddly realistic numbers!!
More importantly, Dejiko!\nYour time card's gone, so just enjoy\nsome shopping while you're here!
Dejiko got fired, nyo!?
From now on, I'll take Akihabara's throne\nas Gamers' manager. You just stay in your room\ndrawing BL doujinshi!
That sounds nice… I mean no, nyo!\nDo you think doujinshi are free\nto make, nyo!?
Doujin activities need money first, nyo!
Anyway! I'm Gamers' manager!\nThat makes me the queen standing\nat the top of Akihabara!
//Event art: Usada laughing loudly
O-ho-ho-ho-ho!
Are those your last words, nyo?
//Event art off
Huh???
With such vulgar manners,\nyou cannot stand above others!
You probably used some dirty trick,\nor took it by force.
Things gained that way are lost in an instant.
What! Don't mock me!\nIf you're gonna mock me, do it after conquering the new Gamers-\nturned into an impregnable fortress!
What do you mean, fortress, nyo!?\nWhat did you do to Gamers, nyo!?
Well, I didn't build it so someone\non Dejiko's level could stand a chance.
Crawl on the ground and be looked down on\nby me from the top floor!\nO-ho-ho-ho-ho!
//Usada leaves into Gamers.
Damn you, Usada!\nI'll corner you and make you bawl, nyo!!
She did call it an impregnable fortress.\nShe's probably prepared plenty of traps.
She's planning to hole up in there.
She sure was confident.
Um, this is a normal shop, right?\nThen if we surround it and wait, they'd surrender when they get hungry\nwithout us even attacking, don't you think?
That's called a siege, it is.\nSafe and reliable, it is.
No! Absolutely not, nyo!!\nI can't stand Usada smirking at me\nuntil she comes out, nyo!!
And Usada's the type who'll never learn unless you punch her head-on,\nphysically, nyo!
But then the shop and its customers\nwould be bothered too…
I'm with Dejiko on this!\nThese things need a raid to get\nexciting, y'know.
Yeah! Let's get everyone evacuated\nand go in with a bang!!
No matter how tight their defenses are,\nthey can't stop\nmy Magical Magic!
Same here! Just try\nand stop me!
I'd rather charge in too!\nBetter to just go for it than wait!
If my wife says so, I have no objections.
True, surrounding a place in a\nbustling district isn't easy either.
Decided! Charge, nyo-!!
Is that okay…?
Dejiko-chan flying into the fire☆ -\nisn't that super cute?
//Battle map: inside Gamers\n//After allies and enemies are placed
Everyone, something's here!
There seem to be traps too.\nBe careful!
Laura, what's your read?
It'd be easy if we could smash through the floor and go up,\nbut if not, this'll be tricky.
Pin-pon-pan-poon!\nWelcome to Manager Usada's\nfortress Gamers! I welcome you!
Usadaaa!\nHow dare you do this to everyone's Gamers!
Do you remember how many days you skipped minding the store?\nComing from you, complaints don't mean muchh?
I didn't skip- I just got dragged\ninto trouble, nyo!
That doesn't matter.\nToday I'll finally beat Dejiko and become\nAkihabara's new queen!
Being the manager of this game shop\nis that big a deal…?\nWhat a world.
Well, that IS amazing!\nBut isn't it a bit TOO amazing…?
Maybe that's just how this world is!
Since this is Dejiko's world,\nit's possible, it is.
I see… my thinking was too rigid.\nI must reflect.
Meaning: don't let your guard down.
I've hired a special gatekeeper for each floor.\nI wonder if you can beat them?
Now, good luck!\nO-ho-ho-ho-ho!
That giddy voice acting like she's already won\nis so annoying, nyo!
She said gatekeeper, right?\nIf we beat them, we can go up? Up?
She should've kept quiet.
Our targets are decided, then.
Find the strongest one\nand beat it! Got it!
//Battle start\n//Clear by defeating each floor's gatekeeper
Hold it! If you wanna go up, you'll have to get past yours truly,\nRicorin!
Nyo!? She just popped out, nyo!
Usada-chan did all sorts of things for me,\nso this is a little\nextra service!
Pfft! Even her allies call her\nUsada, nyoo.
Not being called by her proper name\nis a little sad…
//Clear by defeating Riko.
Well, I guess Ricorin's job is done here?\nThe rest is up to you- bye-bye!
//Riko vanishes.
Okay, to the second floor, nyo!!
Huh!? I just realized!\nIsn't this the format of that\nfamous kung fu movie!
Kung… fu movie? What's that…?
There's a five-storied pagoda, and on each floor\na different martial artist guards it as a warden,\nand the hero defeats them to climb up!
That's it… I'm doing that right now!\nUwah, I'm getting fired up!
Battling is fine, but we also have\nto watch out for traps and such.
She did say it was an impregnable fortress.\nNo telling what's in here…
Not being able to move flashily is a pain too.\nWe need to be careful.
I can't hold back.\nIf a trap triggers, we'll deal with it then.
Getting caught in traps on purpose\nhas its own flair, y'know. Ufufu…
[NOEL]-chan gets all tingly\nover that stuff, right?\nThat side of you is sexy tooo.
Hmm-hmm…
Laura, I don't think you should\ntake notes on that…
Usada's little tricks are nothing to fear, nyo!\nOn to the next, nyo-!!
//Battle end\n//Can save
I wonder what kind of gatekeeper\nis on this floor?
O-ho-ho-ho-ho! She's here, she's here!\nWho it is is a surprise!
It's no fun, nyo!!
//Floor 2 battle start\n//Clear by defeating the floor's gatekeeper\n//The gatekeeper is the Rival
…They're here.
[MERU]!?
I'm not in the mood for chitchat!\nHere I go!!
Teacher! [MERU]'s-!
If you're gonna fight, then fight.\nStudents of Saint Mont Blanc Academy fight\nanytime, anywhere- or am I wrong?
B-but…!
I don't recall raising a weakling- nothing☆
U-understood!\nUuuh, is this okay…
She was probably hired or something.\nI don't plan to fight till she drops☆
R-right! Okay!
Her words are flippant, but she's a warrior at heart…
…Come at me!
[NOEL]!? Why!?
Let's settle whether my magic\nor [MERU]'s yo-yo\nis better!
Teacher! [NOEL]'s-!
Yes, go get her☆
H-huh!?
If my cute student says she'll fight,\nI can't tell her not too.
…Are you enjoying this?
You-betcha crackers☆
Uuuh… I don't get it, but\nokay, for now…
Her phrasing is bizarre, but she's\na strict teacher!
//Clear by defeating the Rival.
Aw man! Did I mess up!?\nI'll be back!!
Muu! I'll let you through here!
//Rival vanishes.
I did it!
Hmm, that kid was subpar.\nDid I teach her wrong…?
Uuuh, but this isn't good enough…
Ahem! I win!
Hmm, that wasn't much of a fight\nto call it a win.
Uuuh, harsh…
Who cares how the student did, nyo!\nA win's a win, nyo!
The result is satisfactory. Let's go to the third floor.
Okay! Can't fight on an empty stomach, nyo!\nWait a bit, nyo.
Um, we don't really have time for a leisurely meal…
So impatient, nyo- eating is also battle, nyo!
Sigh…
//Battle end\n//Can save
There'll probably be some nasty\ntrickery around here.
There is not!\nI didn't set any traps at all!
So obvious it brings tears to my eyes, nyo…
W-well, let's proceed carefully.
From the sound of that voice,\nshe's probably set traps\nin the obviously suspicious spots.
Let's avoid those spots. Sorry to her, though.
//Floor 3 battle start\n//Clear by defeating the floor's gatekeeper\n//The gatekeeper is Nain
…You don't get through here.
You are!?
Twin Phantom…!
Fight…!
Nice stance. Care for a spar?
//Clear by defeating Nain.
…Retreat, understood.
//Nain vanishes.
Ah…
She didn't seem intent on a real fight.
I wanted to talk to her if I could…
Now's no time for chitchat, nyo!\nGet to the fourth floor, nyo!
Y-yeah…
//Battle end\n//Can save
Weell, getting to the climax, I'd say?
Do your best, you must.
Kiii! How dare you get this far!\nIt was so much trouble inviting guests!!
You should do it yourself instead of relying on others, nyoo.
Hmph! You haven't seen the true terror\nof the new Gamers yet!\nGo to hell! Dejiko!
I see, this floor likely has\npitfall traps.
Gulp.
Oh, stop it! I totally don't think\ndumb Dejiko would fall for them!\nReally!
What an easy person to read…
Good girl, Usada, good girl, you are.
In terms of suited or not,\nshe's totally not suited…
But that's what's cute and addictive☆
//Floor 4 battle start\n//Clear by defeating the floor's gatekeeper\n//The gatekeeper is Tesla
You people… how dare you do that to Nacchan…!!
Nyo-nyo!? She's giving off\nsome dark aura, nyo!
I won't hold back anymore…\nAre you prepared…?
Interesting. If that's how it is,\nit'll be worth doing.
Everyone, do your best and beat her, nyo!\nDejiko will cheer you on, nyo!
Just cheering?
I'm saving my strength for the showdown with Usada, nyo!\nThis is a cerebral strategy, nyo!
//Clear by defeating Tesla.
…I let myself\nget a little heated.\nWe should retreat here.
//Tesla vanishes.
Ah, I couldn't talk to her again…
We'll surely get another chance.\nLet's hurry to the floor above.
Yeah…
Is this finally the floor with the bunny lady?
It's Gamers' top floor, nyo!\nUsada, you're not getting away, nyo…!!
//Battle end\n//Can save
You made it all the way up here!
Usada, be honest, nyo. You're freaking out that we made it\nto this floor, nyo?
After defeating all those, of course.
We've gotten serious too!
True, I worked desperately hard to beat Dejiko\nand made all these preparations!\nHaving them smashed through is a shock!
But that doesn't mean I'll surrender-\nthat's not the RabiiennRose I am now!\nCome at me!
Usada's ambitions end here, nyo! No national edition, no warlords saga,\nno turbulent chronicle for you, nyo!
As if!\nI'll show you Rabi-an Musou!
//Battle start\n//Event triggers when Usada and Dejiko engage
Come at me from anywhere! Dejiko!
You've got nowhere left to run,\nso quit acting cool, nyo!
It's when cornered that a manager's\ntrue worth is tested!
That's a fighter, nyo!!
Nope, it applies to all living things!\nI'll show you my hidden power!
//Usada defeated
Kiii! What, what!\nThis is so unfair!
Let me teach you something, nyo.\nUsada's cause of defeat was…
You didn't gather all your helpers on the fifth floor to fight us, nyo!
Wh… I didn't notice!!
Oh, she didn't notice…
//Battle end\n//Background: inside Gamers
Usada! Surrender already, nyo!
Call me RabiiennRose!
Even now, you're hung up on that.
So lively☆\nWant another round?
Doesn't look like she has the strength left.
I'm saying it's checkmate, nyo!\nSay "I give up," nyo!
Giving up here is the old me- but the new me,\nthe new manager, is different!\nLook at this!
Nyuu.
Puchiko-san!?
Do you care what happens to this little one's life?
Usada… are you seriously doing this, nyo?
Help me, nyu. I'm scared, nyu.
O-ho-ho-ho! Well then, bye-bye!
//Usada vanishes to another world, taking Puchiko.
With a hostage… we can't move carelessly.
She had an escape route ready, at least.\nMaybe I underestimated her.
I hope Puchiko-san is okay…
If she's a hostage, she'll be treated carefully,\nso there's probably not much to worry about?
With her personality, she won't just\nkeep running forever. We'll get a chance\nto rescue her.
Still, how did THAT Usada\ncome up with taking\nPuchiko hostage, nyo?
Isn't that something anyone would think of?
Not thinking of that is what makes her Usada, nyo!
She's a good kid, Usada-chan.
Surely there's some bad guy near Usada,\nforcing those underhanded tricks\non her, nyo!
Probably.
Usada's annoying, but that kind of villain\nis even MORE annoying, nyo!!
If that's true,\nUsada-chan's in danger too.\nWe can't leave her alone!
So, what do we do now?\nWe don't know where\nUsada-san fled.
Eve, don't you have some plan?
Hmm, dunnoooo☆\nI haven't looked into how those kids\nvanish yet.
I see, then it can't be helped.
Besides Puchiko, I can't leave Gamers\nlike this, nyo! I'll turn it back into\na proper shop, nyo!
We'll help too, we will.
Yes.\nThe real manager couldn't\ncome back to this either.
So we'll crash here a while\nand help clean up?
Koto-chan, are you the tidying-up type?
Hehe, 'cause this town looks fun!
Right! There are so many shops\nI wanna visit! Ufufu!
I wanna find cute stuuuff!!
Me too!
//Event art: Satoko's fearless grin
(Fufufu… I hear there's a shop in the back alleys\nselling shady equipment and parts.\nMy new trap-making will go swimmingly…!)
I'm not the Satoko Hojo who'll end\nas Hinamizawa's trap master!\nFufufu…!
Um, Satoko? Your face is scary!?
//Event art off
Huh? N-nothing at all?\nO-ho-ho- *cough*, *cough cough*!?
Wh-what's wrong? You okay?\nThere there…
Sorry, Haruka-san.\nI just laughed a little too much.\nFuu…
So you don't get lost, when you go out,\ncome with me, you must.
Understood.
Then, while we help rebuild this place\nfor a while, we'll watch and wait.
//END
